messages:
Noah (People Ops): Heads up  we've published a new Emergency Relocation & Family Travel Assistance policy for urgent family moves (illness, natural disaster, critical caregiver needs). Live link + short FAQ: https://redwood.internal/hr/emergency-reloc :lighthouse:

Jules (IC): What counts as an emergency here?

Noah (People Ops): Short version: unexpected events requiring immediate relocation or extended presence to support a family member (doctor orders, evacuation orders, sudden caregiver requirement). The FAQ has examples and the review rubric.

Sophie (Manager): Effective date? retro?

Noah (People Ops): Effective immediately for new requests. Retroactive consideration for moves since 2026-02-01 on a case-by-case basis.

Marco (Finance): Breakdown of benefits?

Noah (People Ops): Benefits summary: up to 10 workdays paid emergency leave (in addition to PTO), temporary housing stipend up to $200/day for up to 30 days, one-time relocation allowance up to $3,000 for urgent expenses, and partner/spouse one-way economy flight covered up to $1,200 when travel is required for family caregiving support. All reimbursements via expense codes below.

Priya (Legal): Note: relocation allowances may have tax implications in some jurisdictions. We flagged required disclosures and immigration guidance in the doc. People should consult payroll or legal for cross-border questions.

Jules (IC): How do we apply? manager sign-off? turnaround?

Noah (People Ops): Submit an Emergency Relocation request form (link in the doc). Manager confirmation is required to verify operational feasibility; People Ops triages and Finance auto-processes approved reimbursements within 8 business days. For urgent approvals (same-day), DM me or ping #people-ops-emergencies.

Ravi (People Ops): Expense codes to use: REL-LEAVE (for payroll top-up), REL-HOUS (temporary housing stipend), REL-RELOC (relocation allowance), REL-TRVL (partner/spouse travel). Please attach supporting docs (evacuation notice, medical note, travel receipts).

Marco (Finance): We'll mark payments in payroll as "Emergency Relocation Assistance" so teams can identify. Taxable treatment varies; payroll will apply appropriate withholding.

hr-bot: Policy updated: https://redwood.internal/hr/emergency-reloc (view-only). Office hours: Thu 9am PT drop-in for Q&A.

Priya (Legal): Also updated code of conduct excerpt around traveler and host-family safety for emergency stays  added guidance on local laws, consent for sharing medical info, and mandatory incident reporting if safety concerns arise.

Jules (IC): Appreciate the clear process. Quick ask: can contractors access the stipend?

Noah (People Ops): Contractors on active contracts with Redwood for 12+ weeks are eligible for the temporary housing stipend and partner travel assistance but not for payroll leave top-up. See FAQ for edge cases.

Sophie (Manager): Will this affect headcount approvals or remote work exceptions?

Noah (People Ops): No automatic headcount changes. For longer-term relocations (>90 days), coordinate with your manager and People Ops for location/compensation adjustments.

Jules (IC): Thanks. Bookmarking the FAQ.

Noah (People Ops): Thanks all  if you see any ambiguous language in the doc, flag it here and we'll iterate. We're also scheduling a 30-minute town hall next week to walk through scenarios. :calendar:
